nodes.name: Enrich Trigger
nodes.notes: The Blitz lane of Enrich Contacts (2026-09-09). Called once per launch with the whole company list; walks it in chunks of 100, asks Blitz per chunk at its documented pace, hands each chunk to Enrich Contacts Writer (awaited), then writes its own Hub row "<parent execution>-blitz" and answers counters.

nodes.name: Chunk Loop
nodes.notes: One chunk at a time. Loop output: ask the vendor, write, tick. Done output: the lane row and the answer.

nodes.name: BZ Domain To LinkedIn
nodes.notes: Blitz: the company LinkedIn page for a domain. 10 requests a second per endpoint documented; paced at 8.

nodes.name: BZ Employee Finder
nodes.notes: Blitz: everyone at one company page, job_level filtered, max_results = the cap (50 at most, one page).

nodes.name: Call Writer
nodes.notes: Awaited. The writer merges this chunk into People and answers counters; a crash comes back as an error item and is counted, the lane moves to the next chunk.

nodes.name: Log Lane
nodes.notes: The lane's own Hub row, upsert on Execution ID "<parent execution>-blitz", Automation "Enrich Contacts Blitz", Client attached. A failed write is not fatal: the counters still go back to the Rootflow.
